profile.text: Explorer, ore collector, and also a famous content creator on the video side of Columbia's intercity net. Contracted Oripathy due to inattentiveness on a geological excursion, and came to Rhodes Island seeking treatment. After some negotiation, she joined Rhodes Island as a specialist operator, using her ample geological knowledge and survival experience to support our teams on their many outdoor exploration missions.
